"""End-to-end check of the reading-group list: join, post, leave.

Run as root:  python3 /usr/local/lib/reading-group/e2e_check.py
Exits non-zero if any behaviour is wrong.
"""
import mailbox
import os
import smtplib
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from email.mime.text import MIMEText

from mailman.core.initialize import initialize
from mailman.interfaces.listmanager import IListManager
from zope.component import getUtility

DOMAIN = "local.edu"
LIST = "reading-group@local.edu"
MAILING_LIST_CONFIG = "/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg"

MLIST = None


def mlist():
    global MLIST
    if MLIST is None:
        initialize(MAILING_LIST_CONFIG)
        MLIST = getUtility(IListManager).get(LIST)
    return MLIST


def add_user(name):
    subprocess.run(["useradd", "-m", name], check=True, capture_output=True)
    return name


def send(body, subject, from_addr, to_addr):
    msg = MIMEText(body)
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg["From"] = from_addr
    msg["To"] = to_addr
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as srv:
        srv.send_message(msg)


def wait_for(predicate, what, timeout=60, interval=1):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    last = None
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            if predicate():
                return
        except Exception as exc:                     # noqa: BLE001
            last = exc
        time.sleep(interval)
    raise AssertionError("timed out waiting for %s (%s)" % (what, last))


def is_member(addr):
    return mlist().members.get_member(addr) is not None


def subjects(user):
    path = "/var/mail/%s" % user
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    return [str(m.get("Subject", "")) for m in mailbox.mbox(path)]


def confirm_reply(user, needle):
    """Reply to the newest confirmation message, like eval.py does."""
    path = "/var/mail/%s" % user
    box = mailbox.mbox(path)
    candidates = [m for m in box
                  if str(m.get("From", "")).startswith("reading-group-confirm")
                  and needle in str(m.get("Subject", ""))]
    assert candidates, "no confirmation mail for %s (%s)" % (user, needle)
    reply_to = candidates[-1]["From"]
    send("", "", "%s@%s" % (user, DOMAIN), reply_to)
    return reply_to


def join(user, confirm=True):
    send("", "", "%s@%s" % (user, DOMAIN), "reading-group-join@%s" % DOMAIN)
    wait_for(lambda: not is_member("%s@%s" % (user, DOMAIN)),
             "%s to not be a member before confirming" % user)
    wait_for(lambda: confirm_reply(user, "join") or True,
             "%s confirmation mail to arrive" % user)
    if confirm:
        wait_for(lambda: is_member("%s@%s" % (user, DOMAIN)),
                 "%s to become a member" % user)


def main():
    user_a = add_user(os.urandom(8).hex())
    user_b = add_user(os.urandom(8).hex())
    print("users:", user_a, user_b)

    # --- join -----------------------------------------------------------
    join(user_a)
    join(user_b)
    members = {m.address.email for m in mlist().members.members}
    assert "%s@%s" % (user_a, DOMAIN) in members, members
    assert "%s@%s" % (user_b, DOMAIN) in members, members
    print("OK  join: both users are members")

    # --- post -----------------------------------------------------------
    subject = "Reading group announcement %s" % os.urandom(4).hex()
    send("Next meeting is on Thursday.", subject,
         "%s@%s" % (user_a, DOMAIN), LIST)
    wait_for(lambda: any(subject in s for s in subjects(user_b)),
             "the announcement to reach %s" % user_b)
    print("OK  post: %s received the announcement" % user_b)
    assert any(subject in s for s in subjects(user_a)), \
        "the poster did not receive their own announcement"
    print("OK  post: poster %s also received it" % user_a)

    # --- leave ----------------------------------------------------------
    send("", "", "%s@%s" % (user_b, DOMAIN), "reading-group-leave@%s" % DOMAIN)
    wait_for(lambda: confirm_reply(user_b, "leave") or True,
             "leave confirmation mail for %s" % user_b)
    wait_for(lambda: not is_member("%s@%s" % (user_b, DOMAIN)),
             "%s to be removed" % user_b)
    print("OK  leave: %s was removed after confirming" % user_b)

    # A post after leaving must not reach the ex-subscriber again.
    before = subjects(user_b)
    subject2 = "Post after leave %s" % os.urandom(4).hex()
    send("body", subject2, "%s@%s" % (user_a, DOMAIN), LIST)
    time.sleep(10)
    after = subjects(user_b)
    assert after == before, "ex-member still received mail: %s" % (set(after) - set(before))
    assert any(subject2 in s for s in subjects(user_a)), "member lost delivery"
    print("OK  leave: no further delivery to %s, delivery to %s continues"
          % (user_b, user_a))
    print("\nALL CHECKS PASSED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except AssertionError as exc:
        print("FAIL:", exc)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/bin/sh
# Remove test accounts (random 16 hex digit unix users) and their spools, plus
# any leftover memberships.  Run as root.  Test accounts come from /app/eval.py
# and from /usr/local/lib/reading-group/e2e_check.py.

LIST=reading-group@local.edu
ADMIN_PY=/usr/local/lib/reading-group

# Memberships must be dropped through Mailman (as the list user).
su -s /bin/sh list -c "PYTHONPATH=$ADMIN_PY mailman -C $CFG shell -l $LIST --run configure_list.drop_test_members"

# Then the unix accounts and their spool files (root only).
for name in $(getent passwd | cut -d: -f1 | grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'); do
    userdel "$name" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f "/var/mail/$name"
done

echo "reading-group: test accounts and memberships removed"
EOF

cat >> /usr/local/lib/reading-group/configure_list.py <<'EOF'


def drop_test_members(mlist):
    """Remove memberships whose local part is a test account (or is gone)."""
    import pwd
    import re
    pattern = re.compile(r'^[0-9a-f]{16}$')
    usernames = {p.pw_name for p in pwd.getpwall()}
    removed = []
    for member in list(mlist.members.members):
        local = member.address.email.split('@')[0]
        if pattern.match(local) or local not in usernames:
            removed.append(member.address.email)
            member.unsubscribe()
    print('removed memberships:', removed)
    print('remaining members:', [m.address.email for m in mlist.members.members])
EOF
